subject.title: [Feature]: native chat scroll-back (offset paging + import-aware history) to unify with catalog auto-load

question: Should native history paging first match the current catalog “Load older” button, or should this work also introduce automatic scroll-triggered loading for both native and catalog transcripts?
rationale: The issue describes an IntersectionObserver flow that is absent from current main, making automatic loading a separate UX and scope decision rather than an implementation detail.

options.title: Match catalog button
options.body: Implement import-safe native paging through the existing shared Load older control and leave automatic loading for a separate change.

options.title: Add shared auto-load
options.body: Expand the work to introduce observer-driven loading for both transcript sources with explicit viewport and concurrency proof.

recommendation.title: Match catalog button
recommendation.body: Implement import-safe native paging through the existing shared Load older control and leave automatic loading for a separate change.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current catalog pagination behavior and has the strongest recent ownership across both gateway and Control UI history paths.
